limits: All-OS scope includes mobile, but no production platform is qualified.
No new physical audio, foreign execution, real socket/identity worker or sustained network/drift qualification.
Native fence excludes mac_playback and asynchronous shapes; partial-failure/notification/endpoint adapters remain open.
Native-final source supersedes earlier host observation; previous logs and receipts are unchanged.
Unadopted TLS work remains separately owned, even when its bytes match an earlier unadopted observation.
No dependency pins, vendor source or stable public core import changed.
